title: Qwen's First AI Earphones Make Their Debut at the NBA China Game, Can Be Reserved on Taobao and JD.com Official Stores

content_html:
Today, at the NBA China Game event in Macau, the Qwen's first AI earphone was unveiled alongside a new AI glasses model. According to the information, this earphone features a clip-on design that combines Bose sound tuning with Qwen AI assistant capabilities, supporting face-to-face translation, AI note-taking, and voice-based tasks.

The newly launched N1 series AI glasses on display support first-person perspective shooting, object recognition, and other functions. Among them, the N1 Pro is equipped with eye-tracking and iris-based biometric payment features.

Currently, the Qwen AI clip-on earphones and new AI glasses are available for reservation on the official Qwen flagship store on e-commerce platforms, with a planned official release and sales date of October 13th.
